height_note: Current manufacturer page: 1542 mm. Does not assert exact incident vehicle trim/year.
reference_images: AI four views from gpt-image-2.5-flare plus manufacturer design page; no CAD/scan or measured orthographic blueprints.
construction: Analytical body lofts with independent arch apertures, separate cabin/glass, actual panel gaps and axle-local wheel geometry. No whole-model stretch.
materials: Standard PBR factors for paint/glass/metals/lamps, 1024 linear ORM and tangent normal for rubber, explicit mesh normals. No baked lighting or shadows. Glass uses transmission; paint uses clearcoat.
limitations: Silhouette and detailed lamp/wheel design are reference approximations, not OEM CAD.
Track, tyre outer diameter, overhang split and glass curvature are estimated.
Incident-specific vehicle identity and accident damage are not reconstructed.
Interior and underbody are simplified; doors do not open.
